description: List this account's scheduled cost digests — schedule (daily, weekdays, weekly, monthly, quarterly, first/last business day, a chosen weekday or day of month, or custom dates, all UTC), scope (whole account, one cost source, or one cost-allocation tag value), every destination alert channel with the outcome of its last delivery, the layout of widgets it shows (null = the standard digest), and when the next one is due. `next_period_label` names the concrete date range the next digest will cover. Mirrors GET /api/accounts/:accountId/scheduled-reports. Creating and editing are the create_scheduled_report / update_scheduled_report tools.
name: list_scheduled_reports
